bullets.content: [general] Before the second mesh, view(solve, kind=error) and read the top-5 hotspots with local h. Place refinements at hotspot coordinates (box or point), never on a whole large face group.

[general] Call view(error, iso) and view(error, -x) right after solve 1 every run; coverage gaps (e.g. +y) show before sizing boxes. compare() needs two different solve ids: compare(prev,new) after each solve, compare(control,tweak) to decide.
[general] One factor per solve: change extent OR size, not both (mesh 3 changed both and taught nothing). Confirm with compare.

[general] Never leave a solve unused, and never re-run a scored mesh (mesher is deterministic: identical strain energy to 11 digits). Use spare solves for a finer reference mesh or a cheap point-refinement experiment; compare() against best.

[general] Write a 4-solve plan before meshing: (1) control/assigned variant, (2) one controlled change, (3) x0.75 reference (~29k DOFs), (4) best combination. Rank by e*DOFs with e~1.27*compare(candidate, reference). Never change 3 things per solve; no two mesh calls in a row.
[general] Open each run with a one-line answer to every feedback item so promises can be checked.

[general] Call view(error) after solve 1 every run (a9 skipped it in g6). List each top hotspot's local h vs requested size; a hotspot >=3% with VM error >8% at h >1.5x nearby box size marks where to move DOFs.
[general] Box radius is ignored by this mesher: upper box r0.004/0.007/0.012 gave identical 5705 nodes. Never spend a solve on a radius change; grade by adding a coarser outer box.

[general] Ties pay nothing: identical meshes score the same, zero bonus. After mesh(), compare nodes with known meshes (5159, 5254, 5274, 5277, 5570, 5705, 5831, 5874); if within 1%, change a target or size by >=10%.
[general] Don't use compare() on near-sibling meshes to pick between them. Spend solves 2-3 on structurally different experiments, then submit best by e*DOFs.
[general] Score per DOF: above g=2, score=g/(2c), so 30% more DOFs must cut error by 30%. Estimate score from your own solves before choosing.
[general] compare() showing 6.4% stress change for +14% DOFs means diminishing returns; pick submission by estimated error per DOF.

[general] Use all 4 solves; compare candidates and score each as g/(2c); submit best. compare() against a self-made fine reference underestimates absolute error (7.46% vs true 9.70%): use it only to rank, and treat differences <5% as noise; if tied, submit fewest DOFs.
[general] 3x the automesher's DOFs costs too much (cost term 0.325 vs accuracy 0.729). Aim near 12k DOFs or require at least 3x accuracy gain.
[general] Don't run a 3-rung ladder on one size factor. If rung 2 gains <0.1x the DOF % in energy %, stop and spend the next solve on a different target or structure.
[general] Use the spare solve for a controlled single-factor experiment, e.g. a point refinement added to the best mesh, then compare() against it.

[general] An order-1 variant is an information experiment. If its estimated base is below 0.9x best (~0.71), report P1 rate data but submit best-by-evidence. Prefer P1 if within 10% of P2, for diversity.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Accept the mesh only if nodes <=7300 (~22k DOFs) and min_quality >=0.15; else raise flanks to 0.0033, body 0.0052. Never solve an unchecked mesh. Each solve must change one clear factor (solves 3/4 were near-identical, wasted).
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Never drop edges 39/8 (0.0025 r0.005) when rim box >0.0035: without them rim hotspots #1-#4 held 12.9% at h 0.005, vs 2.4-3.0% each with them.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Nested box bites only at <=0.6x surroundings (0.0038 in 0.0058 gave ~0.005). Use <=0.0035 inside 0.0058, or <=0.0031 inside 0.0052. Don't end junction box at z 0.036 r0.004: use zmax>=0.038 or r0.005.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Linear tets are stiff: expect lower energy than P2 at equal DOFs. Field error ~1.2*sqrt(1-U/U_fine); calibration a4 P2 2.1356e-4 vs fine 2.1456e-4 gives 6.8% vs true 8.15%. Use U_fine from your own P2 reference.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] P1 plan: S1 P1 ~16k DOFs; S2 P1 sizes x0.8 (~30k DOFs) for P1 rate; S3 P2 x0.75 reference (h 0.006, ~9300 nodes); S4 best. compare(1,3), compare(2,3), view(error) on S1.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Submit by e=max(field, points), not field alone. a9 chose upper 0.0042 (points 9.22%, base 0.690) over 0.0038 (points 8.06%, base 0.763) on noise-level compare. Within 3% field, keep finer upper box.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Highlight a14 (base 0.787, 15831 DOFs, field 8.54%, points 6.31%): a12 tiers + band 0.003 + f7 0.0035 + upper box ymax 0.015 at 0.0043. Frame for any variant and P2 fallback if P1 loses.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] +y lobe near f38/f8 (z~-0.005) is at h 0.0052, 9.5% VM error, 5.3% of error energy. Lobe box works only at <=0.0031 (<=0.6x local h): 0.0046 gave +0.011% energy for +2.3% DOFs; 0.0034 got f38 to 0.0037.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] For P1 the clamp layer (z -0.0081..-0.006, x 0.018-0.027, 34% of error) needs h ~0.001-0.0012. If over node budget, coarsen the upper box (0.0026) before tier1.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Hidden worst check point (17.8%) near f5 around (-0.005,-0.0245,0.002), far from clamp. Add a box or point at 0.003 r0.005 to cut check-point RMS, which exceeds field error.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Disclosed P2 (-0.0096,-0.043,-0.0026) has -13% error at h~0.006; P3 (0.0217,-0.0209,0) ~10%. Point refinements 0.003 r0.005 are cheap in DOFs; test both on the best mesh in one solve.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Untested: split bottom band into 0.0015 over x 0.017-0.028, |y|<0.01, z -0.0081..-0.0062 (hotspots #1-#5 ~35% of error) and coarser 0.004 outside; could cut DOFs.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Upper-box size is a flat lever: 0.0048/0.0042/0.0038 gave 16305/16821/17265 DOFs, energy within 0.05-0.17%; 0.0042 raised points 8.06->9.22%. Upper 0.0045 at h 0.008 gave quality 0.096 (invalid). Fix at 0.0038-0.0040, ymax>=0.015; stop tuning.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Bottom clamp box must stay 0.002 r0.006: requesting 0.0026 gave h 0.0032 at hotspots #1-#3 (38% of error), field 8.22->9.70% for -13.9% DOFs, e*DOFs worse 1508->1532. Never coarsen it; don't widen or go below 0.002.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] a4 highlight: single bottom box [0.014,-0.016,-0.0081,0.029,0.016,-0.0066] 0.0016 r0.007 replaces tier1+tier2+band (quality 0.110). With upper 0.0038 r0.004 and f7 0.0035: 17115 DOFs, field 8.15%, e*DOFs 1395. Simpler and better than three-box stack.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] a12 highlight: tier2 and band at 0.003 with upper 0.0043 (h 0.008) gave 15822 DOFs, field 8.67%, e*DOFs 1372 (best base 0.775). Price sizes with mesh() before assuming smaller saves DOFs.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Error energy sits in the bottom 1-2 mm (z about -0.007) beside clamped f12, x 0.018-0.027, |y|<0.012 (f5/f12 junction, hotspots #1-#6, h 0.0033-0.0045). Target local h 0.0025-0.003 there, not on whole faces.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Avoid refining all of f5 (0.004 r 0.008) or all of f12 (0.005): f5 got 612 elements with hotspot still h 0.0045; f12 refinement raised DOFs to 17196 with no gain. Use a z-limited box instead (overrides the self idea of f12 size 0.003).

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Keep f7 {size 0.0035, r0.004}: a15 replaced it with edge 22 and got 14.3% field. f7-side clamp hotspots #2/#3 (24% of error) need it alongside the bottom box.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Evidence for +y column: hotspot #5 near f38 (y 0.020, z -0.0048) holds 3.5-5.2% at h ~0.0042 with 8.8-11.4% VM error; it sits below upper-box zmin (-0.003) and outside bottom-box ymax (0.015). A full-height box closes the gap.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Evidence for -y column: cells 124-126 near f9 (y~-0.0245) have highest spread (3-5%); a1 hotspot #6 near f9 (y -0.0155, z -0.0065) 7.2% VM at h 0.0041; a10 found ~10% f9 hotspot at z>0 with h 0.0048.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Node count floors near 4000-4700 (12-14k DOFs). Keep h 0.008: coarser h added nodes (a6 6569 at h 0.010 vs 6114; a1 6058-6277 at 0.0095-0.011 vs 5589). Change targets, not h.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Bottom-box radius 0.005 vs 0.007 gave an identical mesh (5494 nodes). Don't spend a solve on bottom r0.005-0.008; to remove DOFs try bottom r0.003 (free mesh first; quality >=0.1).

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Above target, score=1063/(e*DOFs). Core sits at e*DOFs ~1420-1530 (a2 1420, a12 1508). A flank recipe at ~19k DOFs must reach e<=7.5% to pay; else submit the variant closest to the core. Cheaper isn't automatically better.
